summary: Automated routing of the committed A6 controller placement did not reach zero unconnected inside the fixed contracts (outline, 4 layers, connector anchors, holes, controls, inherited design rules). The committed board is placed and unrouted; nothing here is a routed or DRC result for it.

placement.note: Router inputs were exported from this placement plus fixed buck/C17 pre-routes; the pre-routes are not in the committed board.

rules_used.relaxations: none: no exclusions, no custom rules, no courtyard changes, no netlist changes

freerouting.execution: offline container (--network none, 2 CPUs, 3 GiB), jar not committed

tools.in_house_router: PathFinder negotiated-congestion grid router (scratch only, not committed); runs r13/r14 stopped at 21-24 nets still overlapping after 14-16 iterations

note_on_counts: best_unrouted is Freerouting's own count at its best pass; it never wrote that state out. final_unconnected_after_import is KiCad 10.0.8 DRC after importing the run's last state and filling GND zones on In1/In2.

jam.where: y 12-35 mm: between the U1 QFN (F, y 11.5) and the SW1 through-hole pins, the U4/U5/Q1 cluster (B, y 19-30) and the fixed TP1-TP5 row (B, y 32.2), with the H1 hole and upper clamp keep-out at y 14.7-18.3 narrowing the channel. Every inner-layer track to the lower half passes here.

placement_finding: Five parts that serve the upper section sit in the lower analog section because no legal 0603 spot exists near their pins: R9 (MODE_A pull-up, y 61.7), R20 (VLED bleeder, y 61.7), R16/R17 (DATA_L/R_3V3 pull-downs, y 48.5) and R12 (LED_BASE pull-down, y 39.6). A free-spot search over courtyards, board edge, through-hole pads, the J3 plug keep-out, the H1/H2 clamp keep-outs and the M2 posts found no closer spot for any of them, so their nets add five full-length runs through the jam.
next: Hand routing in the KiCad 10 interactive router is the recommended next step, starting with the y 12-35 mm section, or a placement change that frees space for the five parts named above. Either way the native gate decides; this file stays as the record of the automated attempts.
